title: ATF v1.0 - Agent Trace Format, surface G (trace.json)

artefact_ref.description: artefact_id@version this run was driven/checked against; null for seed runs

transactions.description: Gesture transactions: one agent gesture with the cells it produced, bracketed by the two states actually observed.

outcome.description: 'observed' where no gate ran (undirected/directed); otherwise the gate's decision.

attempts.description: Gesture transactions that did not advance the process: evidence about the run, not transitions of the contract.

operation_ledger.description: Every proposed agent operation, including pre-execution vetoes. Use dispatched/executed to distinguish proposals that reached the environment; execution events record operations that crossed that boundary.

experiment_id.description: Declared before execution; membership of an experiment is not decided by recency.

contract_content_hash.description: The content hash of the contract this run was checked against.

block.description: Randomised block index; arms are interleaved rather than run in sequential batches.

monitor_transitions.description: Transactions that advanced the residual contract.

unapplied_events_recorded.description: LEGACY recording-policy flag. True means operations that reached the environment but were not applied are still execution events. Pre-execution gate vetoes are never execution events and belong in interventions/operation_ledger.

interventions.description: Agent proposals refused before dispatch. They are evidence about enforcement, not execution events, because the world was never touched.

runtime_findings.description: Faults diagnosed after an operation executed. Unlike interventions, these belong to the executed history and cannot be retroactively vetoed.

guard.description: Guard grammar S4 (ASCII rendering): true | L | G /\ G ; L ::= f | not f | f op k

pre.description: FULL store projection; keys must equal store_schema keys

post.description: FULL store projection; keys must equal store_schema keys

txn.description: Identifier of the gesture transaction this cell belongs to.

txn_position.description: Index of this cell within its transaction. Per-cell pre/post inside a transaction is an attribution under a stated convention; only the transaction's own pre/post were measured.

advanced.description: Did this operation advance the residual contract? False = executed but held.

applied.description: Did the environment apply the requested state change? An execution event exists only after the operation crossed the runtime boundary; a pre-execution gate refusal is retained as an intervention/ledger proposal instead. Distinct from 'advanced', which says whether the monitor residual moved. Absent means applied.
